help.page.overview.title: Overview
help.page.overview.description:
The event revolves around individual progression, light competition, and server interaction.

Use `/perfil` to check your current state and inventory, `/loja` to buy things, `/tabuleiro` to move on the map, `/missao` to track goals, and `/cestas` to open stored rewards.
help.page.economy.title: Currencies and Resources
help.page.economy.description:
<:sweetcoins:1496365065773781033> **Sweet Coins**: main event currency.
<:trickcoins:1496364971398008932> **Trick Coins**: currency for trick items.
🎲 **Dice**: used to roll on the board.
✨ **XP Bank**: stored XP for event closing.

You get resources from the board, missions, baskets, Candy Shower, Carousel, and other event rewards.
help.page.missions.title: Missions
help.page.missions.description:
There are 3 types:
🕯️ **Personal daily mission**
🎃 **Server-wide daily mission**
👻 **Event-wide mission**

Rewards are now granted the moment a mission is completed, without needing to open `/missao`.
help.page.board.title: Board
help.page.board.description:
In `/tabuleiro`, each roll consumes 1 die and moves your character.

You earn rewards from tiles, receive sweets, trick coins, baskets, and accumulate completed laps. Curse tiles now apply a curse pool with light loss, temporary debuffs, or a small chance to become an item. The board remains one of the main progression sources in the event.
help.page.events.title: Events
help.page.events.description:
**The Observer**
A public question event. The first correct answer in chat wins the round reward.

**Corrupted Signals**
Some rounds show an anagram in a visual transmission. Rearrange the letters and send the answer in chat before the other players.

**The Observer Files**
Some rounds show an old server message with its name and avatar hidden. Freely guess who wrote it; there are no multiple-choice options, and searching Discord history is part of the investigation.

**Candy Shower**
For a few minutes, event chat messages may receive candy drops that players can capture with reactions. Every capture is counted in the final reward summary.

**Carousel**
A competitive event with entry by Carousel Ticket. Rounds eliminate participants until only one winner remains.

**Ghost Train**
When the event chat reaches its message goal within the configured time window, a Ghost Train passes through the channel with a short bonus stop. Each player may board once and choose between Sweets or Tricks.
help.page.candy_hunt.title: Candy Hunt
help.page.candy_hunt.description:
While the server chats in the event channel, a valid message may start a **Candy Hunt**. The bot shows several reactions and points out which candy you need to find.

Each person gets **one attempt per appearance**. The first correct choice before time runs out earns candy. The mechanic may pause while another public event is active.
help.page.items.title: Items and Inventory
help.page.items.description:
Use `/perfil` to view your items and `/usar` to activate an item.

Right now, the main working items are `mute`, `switch`, `interferencia`, `Observer Hint`, and `Carousel Ticket`. Baskets now exist in 3 tiers: `Candy Basket`, `Rare Basket`, and `Cursed Basket`. They can be opened in `/cestas` and concentrate a large share of the event's special items.
help.page.commands.title: Commands
help.page.commands.description:
**Player**
`/perfil`, `/loja`, `/tabuleiro`, `/missao`, `/usar`, `/cestas`, `/lang`, `/help`

**Admin**
`/setup`, `/evento`, `/observador arquivo`, `/admin`, `/fechamento`

The `/setup` panel also publishes or updates the rankings. The `/evento` panel starts Observer, Candy Shower, and Carousel manually.

julgamento.base.title: 🎠 Carousel of the Condemned
julgamento.base.description:
*"When the Manifest Consortium called into the void, something answered."*

This is the Carousel stage. Official rounds happen here.
The audience follows from the side thread — but only living players may answer.
julgamento.base.rules_value:
1. Tickets are handed out — signups stay open for a limited time.
2. Each round is announced before the question appears.
3. When the question drops, anyone who fails or stalls falls.
4. The Carousel keeps spinning until only one player remains.
